diagnostic_input: the exact DEM TIFF path and original complete sampled rows already obtained in each frozen GSI chunk
candidate_sample_rule: stable sorted complete candidate_cell_id; integer linspace positions from first to last; never by terrain score, occurrence or field outcome
exact_value_comparison: float64 elementwise exact equality, including original vs replay1 and replay1 vs replay2
dem_content_guard: SHA256 the exact sampled DEM file before and after both repeated calculations; abort if changed
failure_or_missing_source_handling: report unavailable selected chunks separately; never treat as ecological absence
next_gate: If the exact same file produces different numerical vectors within one process, isolate the numerical reader/transformation stage. If all sampled vectors agree, cross-run differences remain unresolved; never infer that all chunks or field outcomes are deterministic.
